coverage.evidence: commandDraft.ts:56-58 and 94-96 hold minPermissionLevel, cooldownSeconds and userCooldownSeconds. CommandEditor.vue:307-321 puts the Who can use it select first. CommandEditor.vue:369-420 puts the Chat cooldown (seconds) and Per-person cooldown (seconds) inputs (min 0, step 1) in the Trigger and cooldowns collapsible. The labels are in commands/i18n/en.json:68-78. The heading summary text is at CommandEditor.vue:107-123 with en.json:70-72. Zero means off and nothing is set: ChatMessageHandler.cs:437,451,472-484. The limits are 0 to 86400 in CommandDtos.cs:135-140,196-201 and 0 to 3600 in BuiltinCommandService.cs:29,209-213. New commands default to Everyone (CommandDtos.cs:106) and 0 seconds. The tab is gated by commands:write in CommandsView.vue:52,57-63.

IsCooldownExempt is @event.IsBroadcaster || @event.IsModerator (ChatMessageHandler.cs:1949-1950). It is built from the badge flags only, so roles granted in NomNomzBot do not exempt. The Twitch lead moderator badge also sets IsModerator (ChatTranslators.cs:283-285). SetCooldown runs for exempt users too (ChatMessageHandler.cs:472-484). The offline gate exempts the broadcaster and moderators (OfflineCommandGate.cs:25-27, ChatMessageHandler.cs:299); its label is in settings/i18n/en.json:107. The footer count is one per changed field (CommandEditor.vue:104-105,124-128; commandDraft.ts:180-190; en.json:77).

ChatMessageHandler.cs:418-487 runs in this order: the permission check (419-431), the global cooldown (434-448), the per-user cooldown (451-469). Both SetCooldown calls (472-484) run only after every gate passes, so a refused try restarts nothing. Exemption is IsCooldownExempt(@event) at 435. Built-in commands use the same order at 333-376. The cooldowns live in an in-memory ConcurrentDictionary singleton (CooldownManager.cs:26, DependencyInjection.cs:1112).

Moved to /reference/settings/permissions, which exists and is linked twice from the page. The badge-to-rung mapping on this page matches: ChatRole.cs Resolve; Twitch subscriber or founder at ChatTranslators.cs:278; Kick at KickWebhookIngest.cs:285-290; YouTube owner, moderator and member at YouTubeLiveChatPollWorker.cs:577-580. The higher of badge and granted role counts (EffectiveLevelLookup.cs:38, Math.Max). The ladder order is PermissionLevel.cs:22-29 and api/permissions.ts:30-38, with labels in en.json:103-112.

reader_answers.evidence: The role select (CommandEditor.vue:307-321) offers every rung, and a gate pass is level >= floor (EffectiveLevelLookup.cs:41-42). The cooldown inputs are in the Trigger and cooldowns collapsible (CommandEditor.vue:369-420). Save is 'Save changes' (en.json:78). A system command's fields are disabled until Customize.

Editing needs commands:write (CommandsView.vue:52,167; BuiltinsController.cs:76), which is Moderator by default (ActionDefinitionSeeder.cs:180). The Bot manager capability covers creating and editing commands (settings/permissions/i18n/en.json:409-412).

The unsaved text is empty when dirtyCount is 0 (CommandEditor.vue:124-128), and the baseline resets after save (CommandEditor.vue:192). The collapsed heading shows limitsSummary (CommandEditor.vue:107-123,377). The chat cooldown key is per channel and the per-person key is per user (CooldownManager.cs:104-108).

The global and per-user checks are independent, and both must pass (ChatMessageHandler.cs:436-469). A run resets the global expiry to now+duration (CooldownManager.cs:77-86). A refused try returns before SetCooldown (ChatMessageHandler.cs:467-468). An expiry at exactly now counts as ended (CooldownManager.cs:44), so A runs at second 60.
